messages:
elaine: quick thread to lock the visibility roadmap scope for Q2 kickoff. goal: ship a usable console surface that helps customers find cost regressions and high-error routes. main pillars: dashboards (cost + errors), lightweight tracing pointers, billing-grade route accounting (opt-in), and basic alerting.
rajesh: +1. We need firm launch gates. I'd add RBAC for visibility data (customer admins only) to avoid exposing PII.
hannah: design constraints: small-footprint UI. propose single "Incident" view combining error spikes, top routes, and quick trace links. separate "Billing" tab for per-route cost.
mike: runtime constraints: sampling strategy matters. Suggest baseline 0.2% sampling, auto-capture on error (>=5xx or latency > 10s), and a sampled tail-capture for requests hitting percentile thresholds.
sophia: CS: pilots care about model-version breakdowns in error/cost. also they want a way to mark a route as "billing-exempt" during experiments.
elaine: ok. two immediate trade decisions: 1) per-route billing precise vs heuristic at launch, 2) backfill window (24h vs 72h). proposals below.
rajesh: for security: default visibility to account-admins and add a customer-managed allowlist for support engineers. RBAC MVP can be role toggle + audit log.
hannah: UI will surface a confidence meter for any heuristic numbers. full-precision badge only when `x-route-id` header is present.
mike: precise accounting requires `x-route-id` at ingress and propagation through runtime. overhead is tiny but SDKs and proxies must adopt. if not, heuristics via path+model will be used.
sophia: pilots said they'd enable `x-route-id` for a fee if it gives exact billing; they want migration docs. billing-bot: notice: pricing impact workflow requires 2-week lead for customers.
elaine: proposals: A) Ship heuristics day 0, precise `x-route-id` path in phase 2. B) Require `x-route-id` for billing tab at launch (blocks self-serve). I'm leaning A to reduce friction. thumbs?
rajesh: A with strong nudges and SDK examples. also RBAC must be in day 0.
hannah: A is fine. I'll mock the UX for heuristics + migration CTA.
mike: A + implement a toggle to compute retroactive precise bills if customer later enables headers (async backfill).
sophia: ok. backfill decision: pilots want 7d visible, but infra cost spikes. propose 48h realtime + 7d rollup (aggregated) at launch.
mike: feasible: keep raw traces 48h, rollup metrics 30d. retention config: traces: 48h, rollups: 30d. infra-bot: note: predicted infra delta for these retention settings: +10% monthly.
elaine: launch criteria (draft):
- Dashboards: Top-10 routes by cost & errors visible; panels render <2s P95.
- Tracing: quick-links to sampled traces; trace-on-error and manual capture API. sampling default 0.2%.
- Billing: heuristic per-route cost with confidence band; exact per-route if `x-route-id` present and validated.
- Errors: automatic grouping and fingerprinting; ability to annotate groups.
- Alerts: simple alert rule builder (threshold on error-rate or cost-delta) + notifications to webhooks and email.
- Security: RBAC for visibility and audit logs enabled.
- Docs: migration guide for headers + SDK snippets, and pilot runbook validated by 2 customers.
- SLOs: dashboard queries <2s P95, ingestion lag <5m P95, backfill <48h for last 48h window.

rajesh: add gating: finance sign-off for retention delta and support on rollouts.
hannah: UX ownership: I'll deliver mocks for Incident view + Billing tab by Friday.
mike: runtime ownership: I'll add trace capture API and sampling flags (feature.visibility.sampling_rate). ETA Wed.
sophia: pilot coordination + comms: I'll validate with two pilots and collect feature-flag requests. ETA next Tue.
elin: (typo)
elaine: noted. action items:
- mike: implement sampling config + manual capture API, enable trace-on-error (ETA Wed).
- rahesh: (rajesh) implement RBAC + audit logs for visibility (ETA Fri).
- hannah: mock Incident view + Billing tab with confidence UI (ETA Fri).
- sophia: pilot comms + runbook + migration docs for `x-route-id` (ETA Tue).
- finance: review infra delta for retention settings (+10%) and approve (ETA Mon).
- infra-bot: scheduled canary deploy for visibility:v0.2 -> 2123456860 (owner: mike)
billing-bot: note: customers enabling precise billing will be billed starting next invoice cycle.
rajesh: one more: add an "experimental" flag for customers to opt-in higher sampling (for debugging). don't make it default.
mike: will add feature.visibility.sampling_override per-customer.
hannah: small UI ask: in Alerts, include a "snooze" and "acknowledge" action.
sophia: CS will train pilots on acknowledge flow.
elaine: wrap-up: we ship with heuristics + 48h raw retention + 30d rollups + RBAC + alerts. follow-ups on finance and canary. reconvene after canary metrics. :white_check_mark:
